summary_en: CRESCO increased shares to be cancelled from 1 million to 2 million shares, representing 5.1% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026. The cancellation is scheduled for December 2, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment to "Notice Regarding Decisions on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock"
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, CRESCO's Board of Directors amended a May 8, 2026 resolution on treasury share cancellation. The company increased the number of shares to be cancelled from 1 million to 2 million shares, and confirmed the cancellation date as December 2, 2026. Based on a comprehensive assessment of recent stock market conditions, the company decided to enhance the scale of the cancellation.

As of September 30, 2026, CRESCO held 2,534,902 treasury shares against 39,465,098 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The 2 million shares to be cancelled represent approximately 5.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
